Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::checkBalance(): Real {
	definition:
		inputCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = InputCard.CardID and
		o.Password = InputCard.Password),
		isValidated: Boolean = PasswordValidated and
		CardIDValidated
	precondition:
		inputCard.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		isValidated = true
	postcondition:
		BankCard.allInstance()->includes(inputCard) and
		result = inputCard.Balance
}
